title: Top tabs: one row, sticky, slimmer on phones

chat.text: Every top tab row across the site becomes one row that scrolls sideways and never wraps. The tab row sticks to the top while the header above it scrolls away. On phones, the side padding is halved so pages use more of the screen.

message.text: Review: fix, 5 findings (1 fix). Report: /framework/ai/../core/Page/tasks/page-mastermind/top-tabs/review/report.md · Shots: /framework/ai/../core/Page/tasks/page-mastermind/top-tabs/shots/127-0-0-1-59088-framework-ai/sheet.png

Landed. Every tab row is now one row that scrolls sideways, and on a phone the framework header scrolls away while the tabs stay stuck at the top (try /framework/ai/queue/ on the phone). Phone side padding is halved for every page (one setting, not a 'slim' modifier, because every page had the double padding). The AI title and tabs stay on one row, as your quick fix asked.
